products.title: SOARING HIGH
products.body_html:
Introducing the Soaring High T-Shirt
Crafted from luxury heavyweight organic cotton, this oversized tee is a statement in both comfort and design. Featuring a bold 40-inch screen print stretching from sleeve to sleeve, it's made for those who aim high — and wear it proud.

Product Details:

  • Color: Candle Cream

  • Fabric: 100% Organic Cotton, 250 GSM

  • Fit: Oversized

  • Graphic: 40-inch screen print (from sleeve end to sleeve end)

  • Shipping: Free shipping across India

  • Dispatch Time: All orders ship within 24 hours
